integrity: All claimed line/point incidence computations are reproducible from the embedded standalone Python program. Arithmetic extension formulas and cohomology rely on the stated proofs and published Hermitian/K3 facts, not solely on finite calculations. No independent audit was performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to the fixed reduced complete 112-line divisor on the displayed F3 Fermat quartic, with rational l-adic coefficients for l different from three. General quartic twists, integral cohomology and arbitrary boundaries are excluded. Literature priority remains subject to independent verification.
title: Frobenius cohomology of the complete line boundary on the ternary Fermat quartic
